title: Finite-coefficient K-theory of henselian valued fields and Gersten injectivity
summary: Let $W$ be a henselian valuation ring with fraction field $L$, residue field $k$, and value group $Γ_W$. Let $N=\ell^ν$ be invertible in $W$. Choose an ordered $\mathbf Z/N$-basis $B$ of $Γ_W/NΓ_W$. Products of suitable classes define an equivalence of complete filtered spectra $$ \bigoplus_{\substack{J\subseteq B\\J\text{ finite}}} Σ^{|J|}\operatorname{Fil}_{\mathrm{mot}}^{\bullet-|J|} K(k;\mathbf Z/N) \xrightarrow{\simeq} \operatorname{Fil}_{\mathrm{mot}}^{\bullet} K(L;\mathbf Z/N) $$ The summand indexed by $\varnothing$ is the generic restriction map, after the rigidity equivalence…
